notes_zh:
- **新增** App 已完成 Apple 开发者签名与公证：下载安装不再被 macOS 拦截提示「无法打开」，之后每次升级也不再需要重新授权辅助功能（感谢 @CoZooo 提供签名与公证支持）
- **说明** 升级到本版本时，因签名身份变更需重新授权一次辅助功能，此后永久保留
- **修复** 全局快捷键在 macOS 26/27 测试版系统上可能导致的崩溃
notes_en:
- **New** The app is now signed and notarized with an Apple Developer ID: downloads are no longer blocked by macOS, and future updates will no longer require re-granting Accessibility permission (thanks @CoZooo for sponsoring the signing & notarization)
- **Note** Upgrading to this version requires re-granting Accessibility permission once due to the signing identity change; it persists permanently afterwards
- **Fix** A crash that global hotkeys could trigger on macOS 26/27 beta systems

beta.notes_zh:
- **修复** 一次性复制上千个文件时，快捷面板 / 主窗口预览该条记录会卡死数秒的问题（文件列表改为按需渲染，图标与统计信息改为缓存 / 异步计算）
- **修复** 快捷面板切换分类再切回来后，选中项停留在中途分类自动选中的条目上的问题；现在每次切换分类都选中该分类的第一条
beta.notes_en:
- **Fix** Selecting a clip with thousands of copied files no longer freezes the quick panel / main window preview (file list now renders lazily; icons and stats are cached / computed asynchronously)
- **Fix** Switching category tabs back and forth no longer leaves a stale selection carried over from the intermediate tab; each switch now selects the first item of that category
